about: Files moved here from the hook dispatcher on the person's computer, a private repository: each names its source commit, the BLAKE3 identity of its source path (from_path_identity, so the path itself is not published), of its source bytes and of its bytes as first committed here (the same bytes). check_switches.py then gained the run verb and a door named by the environment (ports/check-switches.json); the dispatcher there imports these copies.
